endpoints.name: List posts
endpoints.notes: Returns all 100 posts as a JSON array. A plain list read is the baseline: with 2 workers and 20 requests the p95 should stay well under the 2 s limit.

endpoints.name: Get post 1
endpoints.notes: Fetch one post by id. A single small object, so it is usually faster than the list.

endpoints.name: Get missing post (404)
endpoints.notes: There is no post 9999, so the server answers 404 with an empty object. The assertion expects 404: a negative test passes when the failure is the right one.

endpoints.name: List comments of post 1
endpoints.notes: A nested route: the comments that belong to post 1. It returns the same data as /comments?postId=1 through a different URL shape.

endpoints.name: Create post
endpoints.notes: The server fakes this write: it answers 201 with the new id (101) but does not store the record, so a following GET /posts/101 returns 404.

endpoints.name: Replace post 1 (PUT)
endpoints.notes: The server fakes this write: it echoes the body back with 200, but post 1 is unchanged afterwards.

endpoints.name: Update post 1 (PATCH)
endpoints.notes: The server fakes this write: it returns the post merged with your change and 200, but nothing is saved.

endpoints.name: Delete post 1
endpoints.notes: The server fakes this write: it answers 200 with an empty object, and GET /posts/1 still returns the post afterwards.

endpoints.name: List comments
endpoints.notes: Returns all 500 comments. A mid-sized list, bigger than /posts but far smaller than /photos.

endpoints.name: Comments filtered by post
endpoints.notes: A query filter: only comments with postId=1. Compare its payload size with the unfiltered list.

endpoints.name: Get comment 1
endpoints.notes: Fetch one comment by id.

endpoints.name: List albums
endpoints.notes: Returns all 100 albums.

endpoints.name: Get album 1
endpoints.notes: Fetch one album by id.

endpoints.name: List photos
endpoints.notes: Returns all 5000 photos, a large payload of about 1 MB per response. Latency is dominated by transfer size, so this endpoint gets a higher p95 limit (5 s). Keep its request count low.

endpoints.name: Get photo 1
endpoints.notes: Fetch one photo by id. Compare its latency with the full /photos list to see what payload size costs.

endpoints.name: List todos
endpoints.notes: Returns all 200 todos.

endpoints.name: Todos not completed
endpoints.notes: A query filter on a boolean field: only todos that are not completed.

endpoints.name: Get todo 1
endpoints.notes: Fetch one todo by id.

endpoints.name: List users
endpoints.notes: Returns all 10 users, each with a nested address and company object.

endpoints.name: Get user 1
endpoints.notes: Fetch one user by id.

endpoints.name: List posts of user 1
endpoints.notes: A nested route: the posts written by user 1.
